name: TrustRoas

sources.title: Homepage — 'database of verified ad spend & revenue' leaderboard for stores, agencies, and freelancers
Add Store — sign-in gate (Continue with Google / Continue with Twitter)

conditions: Free listing requires sign-in (Google or Twitter OAuth) at /add-store
Fit gate: only e-commerce stores, media-buying agencies, or freelance media buyers — verification needs Facebook Ads API and Shopify API access
requirements: Entity types: store, agency, or freelancer in the media-buying / DTC space
Ad spend is verified through the Facebook Ads API — needs a real ad account
Revenue is verified via the Shopify API — needs a real Shopify store
Account sign-in via Google or Twitter is mandatory
preparation: A Shopify store and/or Meta (Facebook) ad account with real spend
Google or Twitter account for OAuth sign-in
Entity type decision (store / agency / freelancer) and a category (Fashion, Beauty, Electronics, SaaS, etc.)
Founder profile handle — leaderboard rows link to /profile/<handle>
workflow: Sign in with Google or Twitter
Add the entity and connect the Facebook Ads API (ad spend) and Shopify API (revenue)
The entity joins the public leaderboard at /store/<slug>, ranked by verified ad spend
watchFor: Wrong fit for pure SaaS with no e-commerce store or paid-ads operation — there is a /category/saas but verification still assumes ad spend + Shopify revenue
Connecting Facebook Ads and Shopify APIs means granting real account access — a security decision
Visible leaderboard rows include demo-looking data ('Demo Fashion Store', N/P ROAS) — platform appears early
Listings can be marked private (row #2 shows '***Private***') — privacy option exists
Sponsored cards ('Advertise — 14/20 spots left') are a paid upsell separate from listing
countsAsLive: The entity appears as a row on the trustroas.com leaderboard with a /store/<slug> page showing verified ad spend
unknowns: Whether a listing is possible without connecting both APIs (store with no ads, or agency with no Shopify)
Pricing for the listing itself — /add-store is gated behind sign-in; only the /advertise upsell is public
Whether SaaS products without Shopify are genuinely accepted
